buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the

Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Copy of Registration Certificate of Firm/Company/LLP/Partnership Firm. Certificate of Incorporation, wherever applicable. PAN Card. GST Registration Certificate. Latest GST Return (GSTR-3B) or GST filing proof for the last three months. The bidder shall submit completion certificates/work orders for similar co nsultancy services executed during the last three years. Similar Works: Consultancy services for Design, Survey, Planning, Sewerage Net work, STP, ETP, Water Supply Projects, Environmental Engineering Projects, Mun icipal Infrastructure Works or equivalent. Completion certificates should indicate: Name of work. Scope of consultancy. Agreement value. Date of commencement and completion. Performance certificate from client. 5. Key Technical Personnel Details along with qualification and experience certificates of the following profe ssionals: Team Leader / Chartered Civil Engineer. Environmental Engineer. Structural Engineer. Hydraulic Design Engineer. Survey Engineer. CAD Expert / Draftsman. The bidder shall submit: Qualification certificates. Experience certificates. Valid membership certificates of professional bodies, wherever applicable. 6. Survey Equipment Details Undertaking indicating availability/accessibility of: DGPS Equipment.

Total Station Equipment. Survey Software. AutoCAD/Civil 3D or equivalent design software. Ownership proof or lease agreement shall be submitted. 7. Undertaking for Design Vetting An undertaking on firm's letterhead confirming that: Structural designs shall be vetted from IIT/NIT/Government Engineering Coll ege. Cost of vetting is included in the quoted rates. No extra payment shall be claimed on this account. 8. Authorization Letter Power of Attorney/Authorization Letter in favor of the person signing the bid doc uments. 9. Declaration regarding Blacklisting A self-certified declaration on firm's letterhead stating that: The firm has not been blacklisted/debarred by any Central Government Dep artment, State Government Department, PSU, MES, Defense Organization o r Autonomous Body during the last five years. 10. OEM/Technology Details (If Applicable) The bidder shall submit: Proposed STP technology details (SBR/MBBR/SBT/ASP or equivalent). Brief note on proposed treatment process. List of at least three successfully completed STP projects based on similar t echnology. 11. Quality Certification Copy of valid ISO 9001 certification or equivalent quality management certificati on, if available. 12. Acceptance of Scope and Time Schedule

A duly signed undertaking confirming acceptance of: Scope of work. Stage-wise deliverables. Completion period of 120 days. Submission of hard and soft copies. Requirement of revisions/modifications without additional cost till final appr oval. 13. Integrity Pact / Bid Acceptance Certificate The bidder shall submit a duly signed and stamped certificate stating that: All terms and conditions of the bid are accepted. Information furnished in the bid is true and correct. 14. MSME/Startup Certificate (If Applicable) Valid Udyam Registration Certificate or Startup Recognition Certificate for claimi ng admissible benefits under Government policies. Special Mandatory Undertaking The bidder shall submit an undertaking that the complete design shall be carried out in accordance with: CPHEEO Manual on Sewerage and Sewage Treatment. Relevant BIS Codes. CPCB/MPCB norms. Latest MES Specifications and SSR. Applicable Environmental Regulations. .
